description: A Swift class named AgentEventStore that manages a collection of ControlAgentEvent objects, including appending new events, maintaining a maximum number of stored events, and clearing the event list.

classes.name: AgentEventStore
classes.description: A singleton class managing a list of ControlAgentEvent instances with methods to append, clear, and maintain a maximum size.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new ControlAgentEvent to the store, ensuring the total number of events does not exceed maxEvents.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stored events in the store.
